summary: Procure 60 temporary Notion enterprise seats for Q2 contractor surge and enable SCIM provisioning
description:
Issue summary:
We need to procure a temporary pool of Notion Enterprise seats (60 seats) to support a planned contractor surge across Research and MLOps for Q2. Seats must be SCIM-provisionable and scoped to a contractor group with limited access templates.

Business impact / why this is time-sensitive:
- Contractors start 2026-04-01 and require access to company workspaces and templates for onboarding.
- Without seats and SCIM automation we will incur significant manual provisioning time (approx. 8+ hours/week) and onboarding delays.
- Research experiments are time-boxed; delayed access risks missing project milestones and incremental costs to other teams.

Requested deliverables:
- Procure 60 Notion Enterprise seats on a 3-month prorated term (2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30).
- Enable SCIM sync via our Okta tenant; map attributes per the contractor role profile.
- Configure a dedicated contractor workspace with read-only templates for legal/HR-sensitive docs.

Approvals & cost center:
- Cost center: RND-03 (Research & Applied ML)
- Approvals required: Finance, Legal (review T&Cs for contractor data access), Security (confirm SCIM and admin constraints).

Vendor details and constraints:
- Current Notion account exists under org: redwood-tech (admin: product-ops@redwood.com).
- We must not merge contractor workspace into main production content spaces. Prefer separate workspace with cross-linked templates.
- Preferred billing: monthly invoice charged to Redwood (not contractor-managed).

Next steps / proposed plan:
1) Procurement: request quote and prorated invoice for 60 seats for 3 months and confirm seat reassignment policy.
2) Legal: quick T&Cs check to ensure contractor data retention/transfer rules are acceptable.
3) Identity: enable SCIM provisioning and test mapping for 5 pilot accounts in staging.okta.
4) Ops: create contractor workspace and template set; run pilot on 2026-03-25.

Attachments & Links:
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/notion-contractor-onboarding (see 'Contractor workspace template')
- Slack thread: #vendor-requests (thread ts 1710328123.000400)
- Current org admin contact: product-ops@redwood.com
justification: Short-term contractor ramp for Q2 project deliveries; reduces manual provisioning burden and speeds onboarding for time-boxed experiments.
investigation_notes: Checked existing Notion org: 'redwood-tech' shows 420 active seats and admin contact product-ops@redwood.com.
Confirmed current billing contact does invoice-to Redwood billing alias; finance will accept vendor invoice if PO attached.
Verified Okta SCIM connector is available on our identity org; previous SCIM sync used for 'asana' and 'slack' and requires admin token rotation.
Security note: requested contractors must not have 'admin' privilege in Notion; plan is to provision with 'member' role and restricted pages.
Estimate: Identity team needs ~3 business days to configure SCIM mapping and run pilot after vendor enables provisioning for the workspace.
Risk: Vendor may have minimum seat increments; procurement to confirm possibility of a 60-seat prorated block (vendor quoting may round up).
